rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on porch overhang) is classic property damage with no third-party involvement or vehicle involvement.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch overhang removed four shingles, estimated repair cost $400. No water intrusion or other damage. Policyholder has a $2,500 deductible, so repair cost falls below coverage threshold, but claim is being routed for formal adjuster review and determination.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off, no water intrusion
